title: Unit Event — The Power of Regret — Episode6 Preparation to Clash

meta.Event Outline: Nene and her friends have made it to their final training destination, the Morinomiya Revue. While Nene goes into the experience excited to further grow as an actress, the boys' separate training and Emu's focus on business studies leave her attending practices on her own...

rows.Line: Morinomiya Music Academy - Courtyard

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
So, you saw everything?
Including that conversation just now?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<Yeah...
Sorry, I didn't mean to peek.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No, that's okay.
I'm actually glad you're here. I'm having trouble digesting what happened.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I do think I was in the wrong back there.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I didn't actually take Imura's feelings into consideration.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Ever since coming here, I feel like my emotions have been all over the place...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Huh?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I've been telling myself to do my absolute best in order to keep growing as an actress...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
But everyone here...
They're all competing too hard against each other...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Also, they seem to have no trouble ignoring anyone in need or pain.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I know that auditions can be tough, but this feels...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
<I know what you mean.
You're supposed to be putting on this show together, so it feels bad that things are like this...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But, is that really...>
Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Byakkomachi!

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
Are you by yourself?
I thought I heard someone else's voice just now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh, no... I'm alone.
Anyway, is something the matter?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I just ran into Imura.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I noticed her crying, so I decided to ask how she was doing. Then, she replied, “I said something really terrible to Kusanagi just now.”

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: She wants to apologize to you, but she's having trouble getting her thoughts together. So, I offered to relay her message to you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Oh...
I see...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank you, Byakkomachi.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: There's no need to thank me.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: But there is something I need to tell you, Kusanagi.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: You still seem to be misunderstanding something.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: What do you mean...? Misunderstanding...?

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: I imagine that you tried to cheer up Imura because you and her are both chasing after the same dream.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: However, no one here at Morinomiya thinks like that.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Rather, we actively refuse to think like that.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Everyone here is striving to make their dream come true by becoming the best performer ever.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Because we all know that, we have no trouble throwing everything we have at each other when push comes to shove.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line:
There is no room for pity.
Rather...

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: Showing pity to your opponent would be inappropriate. This is a serious competition.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If you have the time to feel bad, then you have time to further polish your acting. If you succeed where others have failed, you owe them that much.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Right. I'm here to...)

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: If you disagree with that philosophy, then it would be best if you left this place immediately.

rows.Speaker: Byakkomachi
rows.Line: That's all.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nene...? Are you feeling okay...?>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I think I finally understand, after what Byakkomachi told me.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I realize now that I wasn't fully committing myself.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I came in intending to grow as an actress. But...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I framed it as taking the experience they could give me, and learning what they had to teach me. Deep down, I approached it passively...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I wasn't resolved to fight for and win this role like my life depended on it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Which is why I kept hesitating...
I kept looking around at others...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: But no one here at Morinomiya thinks that way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: They're throwing absolutely everything they have at each other in order to become the best actors they can. In order to win.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Nene...>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <I think your kindness and how you look out for those around you are really wonderful, Nene.>

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <But when push really comes to shove, I think there's something you have to prioritize more.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: And I'm glad I get that now...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm done looking around at everyone else.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I'm going to stand up straight and meet everyone else head-on.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Yeah. Break a leg!>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thanks.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: When I set out into the world, I'm probably gonna find myself clashing with others in much the same way.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So, I'm diving in head first...!!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Ah, Louise!
For you, I am willing to do anything. My life is yours!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(No...
This still doesn't feel right.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (In this scene, Luca's...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (His words sound gallant, but he's definitely feeling a complex mix of emotions.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(He didn't want to hurt anyone.
But there's no turning back now. He has to keep moving forward. Which is why...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
“Ah... Louise!
For you, I am willing to do anything. My life is yours!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Nod*
That's a bit better.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Alright, next...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Hey, are you guys free right now?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? How can we help you, Nene?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's about the character I'm auditioning for right now. I'm having some trouble with his character arc during the second half, so I'd love to hear what you guys think.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Oh, in that case, I'm all ears.
What's causing your trouble?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Me too! I wanna help!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Umm...
The part where Luca's named a deputy commander onwards.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “My charge is clear.”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: “I, Luca Roussel, shall cleanse this land of every last treasonous rebel.”

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hmm... You've definitely improved compared to when you first started, but I feel that you can do better than that, Nene.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I agree!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: This is the scene that heralds Luca's descent into tyranny.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's vital to convey to the audience that the timid boy has taken the first step on a path that ends with him as a complete monster. But how best to do that...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh, what if I used my eyes more...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Your eyes?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, by glowering a bit more... Like this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh wow!
You seem determined to complete your mission no matter what!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Good.
I'll try going with this.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: He sings the final song while taking his last breath in Louise's arms.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Singing while on my side is really hard, so I need to find a solid position and...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
No...
My voice is going to sound funny if act too emotional.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Wait, I know...
I can try that thing Ms. Kazamatsuri taught me.
